name: panel-brief
title: Panel composition working paper
for_each: select id,code from panels order by code

sections.title: Mandate
sections.sql: select code,name,purpose,owner,starts_on,ends_on from panels where id=$1

sections.title: Appointments
sections.sql: select code,expert,position,starts_on,ends_on,status,coalesce(nullif(array_to_string(blockers,'; '),''),'No recorded blockers') as evidence_check from v_term_readiness where panel_id=$1 order by position,expert

sections.title: Notes
sections.sql: select body,actor,to_char(created_at at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as recorded_utc from notes where panel_id=$1 order by created_at

name: appointment
title: Appointment working paper
for_each: select id,code from terms order by code

sections.title: Recorded term
sections.note: Internal draft. Proposed and blocked appointments are not approved. Verify before issue.
sections.sql: select code,panel,expert,position,starts_on,ends_on,status,coalesce(nullif(array_to_string(blockers,'; '),''),'No recorded blockers') as evidence_check from v_term_readiness where id=$1

sections.title: Decision evidence
sections.sql: select decision_evidence from terms where id=$1

name: declaration-check
title: Panel declaration checklist
for_each: select id,code from panels order by code

sections.title: Evidence review
sections.note: Record checks, not a certificate of compliance.
sections.sql: select code,expert,status,coalesce(nullif(array_to_string(blockers,'; '),''),'No recorded blockers') as evidence_check from v_term_readiness where panel_id=$1 order by expert
